system.description:
You can take advantage of potential marks, using the information you learned to dupe them into believing you are on the up-and-up. You can substitute Deception checks for Stealth checks made to Pick Pocket. A successful check does not mean you pick the target's pockets, but rather that you have convinced the target to give you the desired object of their own free will. Generally, a target realizes what they have done at the end of the encounter.

At character level 6, you gain a +1 bonus to these checks. This bonus increases to +2 at character level 8, and +5 at character level 10.
